name: Animoca Brands
description: Animoca Brands Corporation Limited (ACN: 122 921 813) is a global digital assets leader building and investing in impactful technologies and ecosystems to reimagine future economies through AI and the agentic web. It has received broad industry and market recognition including Fortune Crypto 40, Top 50 Blockchain Game Companies 2025, Financial Times’ High Growth Companies Asia-Pacific, and Deloitte Tech Fast. Animoca Brands is recognized for building digital asset platforms such as the Moca Network, Open Campus, Anichess, and The Sandbox, as well as institutional-grade platforms; providing digital asset services to help Web3 companies launch and grow; and investing in frontier Web3 technology, with a portfolio of over 600 companies and digital assets.

capabilities.name: Build
capabilities.description: Creates consumer and institutional products including Moca Network (decentralised identity), The Sandbox (virtual world), Open Campus (education protocol), Anichess (on-chain chess), NUVA (real-world assets), Minds by Animoca Brands (agentic AI), and Anchorpoint Financial (regulated stablecoin issuance). Also developing HKDAP, a Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin, through the Anchorpoint Financial joint venture.

capabilities.name: Accelerate

capabilities.name: Research

products.name: Anchorpoint Financial
products.description: An institutional joint venture established by Animoca Brands, Standard Chartered Bank, and Hong Kong Telecom to participate in the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) stablecoin issuer sandbox. Anchorpoint Financial is developing HKDAP, a Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin, with the aim of being among the first issuers to pioneer this market in the region. The venture bridges Web3 and traditional finance, strengthening Hong Kong's position as a global digital assets hub. HKMA sandbox license approved April 2026.
products.regulatory: HKMA stablecoin issuer sandbox — Hong Kong (April 2026)

products.name: HKDAP
products.description: A Hong Kong dollar-backed stablecoin being developed by Anchorpoint Financial, a joint venture of Animoca Brands, Standard Chartered Bank, and Hong Kong Telecom. HKDAP is designed to enhance financial markets and payments by bridging Web3 and traditional finance under the HKMA stablecoin issuer sandbox framework.

products.name: Minds by Animoca Brands
products.description:
Minds by Animoca Brands is an agentic, persistent AI that starts with a message on Telegram or email. No app, no setup, and no technical knowledge required. It remembers your context, grows with you over time, and can connect across teams and people to get things done together. From tracing a family history to launching an Etsy store to planning a friend's next show, it handles the tasks that usually live across multiple apps, automatically selecting the right tools and skills for the job.

Unlike every tool you've used before, it never resets. Context compounds across every session, every task, every interaction. The longer it runs, the more useful it gets, and the more it becomes yours. As your needs grow, your Mind grows with you, expanding into a coordinated swarm of specialised agents that can negotiate, build, and execute on your behalf. Personal. Persistent. Portable.
